bio: Fancy a delicious meal above the rooftops of Biel? On the sixth floor of the Hotel Elite, in this central location near the railway station, you get a great view of the city and the Jura. The atmosphere is unpretentious, the service is friendly and the cuisine is contemporary, with regional and Mediterranean influences. If you're coming as a group, order a few of the finger food dishes (Amuse) to share....
